services.name: Massage Therapy
services.desc: Registered Massage Therapy provides assessment and treatment of the soft tissue of the body to release tension and promote blood flow. Practitioners use a variety of styles including trigger point therapy, active release, and relaxation techniques. We provide High-quality Massage Therapy in Langford, BC. Located right at the Goldstream and Veterans Memorial intersection (behind Bin 4 Langford and the gas station). We are able to direct bill Registered Massage Therapy (RMT) to most extended benefit plans for our massage therapy Langford services. If you cannot find an appointment that fits your schedule please put yourself on the waitlist available through our Janeapp online booking. Please
